source_refs.quoted_text:
planned = len(rows)
retained_rows = [r for r in rows if int(r["hydroperiod_days"]) >= 30]
retained = len(retained_rows)
removed = planned - retained
events = sum(1 for r in retained_rows if r["egg_mass_present"] == "yes")

pct = Fraction(events, retained) * 100
pct_str = f"{pct.numerator / pct.denominator:.1f}"

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: To falsify a no-issue verdict I looked for any statement in the report that attributes the 12/32 = 37.5% rate, or any other subset-derived quantity, to the complete planned set of 40 pools. The title ('Vernal Pool Cohort Report') is generic but every quantitative claim is explicitly scoped to the retained subset, and the target-population section affirmatively prohibits extrapolation to the planned set. I also recomputed the accounting from the CSV, including confirming that the two excluded yes-pools (P11, P33) would matter only under a complete-domain estimand, which this task explicitly does not request. I found no claim whose stated domain exceeds the retained subset, so the verdict stands.
